<summary>
Task: Fix build failure in a Python repo under /home/github/build/failed/. The agent identified the target repo as AgentOps-AI/agentops (there's also a cacher/env virtualenv).

Turns 1-4: Explored directory structure. Only one real repo: /home/github/build/failed/AgentOps-AI/agentops. The cacher/env is a Python virtualenv.

Turns 5-7: Read pyproject.toml — deps: requests==2.31.0, psutil==5.9.8, packaging==23.2; optional dev: pytest==7.4.0, requests_mock==1.11.0; optional langchain: langchain>=0.0.354. Read tox.ini which installs langchain-core, langchain, openai, tenacity is NOT listed. GitHub workflow runs `tox`.

Turn 8: Successfully installed the package in editable mode with [dev] extras using the cacher venv. Install succeeded — agentops 0.1.8 installed with pytest, requests_mock, etc.

Turn 9: Ran pytest — 5 collection errors, all identical root cause: `agentops/__init__.py` line 12 unconditionally imports `.langchain_callback_handler`, which imports `from langchain_core.agents import AgentFinish, AgentAction`. `langchain_core` is not installed (it's an optional extra). This breaks importing agentops in any test.

Turn 10-11: Inspected `agentops/__init__.py` (line 12 imports LangchainCallbackHandler unconditionally) and `agentops/langchain_callback_handler.py` — imports langchain_core.agents, langchain_core.documents, langchain_core.outputs, langchain.callbacks.base, langchain_core.messages, plus `from tenacity import RetryCallState`. No test file directly imports langchain. Only tests/langchain_handlers/_test_langchain_handler.py (prefixed with _, not collected).

Turn 12-13: Git log — HEAD b0f4a48 (main); tree clean; diverged from origin (14 vs 115 commits).

Turn 14-15: Confirmed no test uses Langchain. Confirmed tenacity is also imported (may be missing too — not listed in deps).

Diagnosis so far: The unconditional import of langchain_callback_handler in __init__.py causes agentops to fail to import when langchain_core is not installed. Fix should make this import optional (try/except ImportError) so that basic tests work without the langchain optional extra. May also need to handle tenacity import gracefully.

Steps remaining: Write failed_reasons.txt with analysis, produce a patch_1.diff modifying agentops/__init__.py (and/or langchain_callback_handler.py) to guard the langchain imports, apply it, and re-run pytest to verify.
</summary>
